purpose: Unified investigation lifecycle management system — orchestrates formal inquiries triggered by challenges, defect discoveries, governance events, or systematic issues across the CMA Part 1 Exam Simulator repository.

version.description: Registry version, incremented on schema changes

nextId.description: Monotonically increasing counter for INV-ID sequence generation

id.description: Unique investigation identifier: INV-{YYYYMMDD}-{NNN} where NNN is a 3-digit zero-padded sequence number

title.description: Human-readable title describing the investigation scope

type.description: Investigation origin type: CHALLENGE — triggered by a student/auto challenge; DEFECT — triggered by a known defect code; GOVERNANCE — triggered by a governance event; SYSTEMATIC — cross-cutting pattern across multiple items

priority.description: Priority score: 1=lowest, 100=highest. Derived from trigger severity and learner-safety impact.

related_qids.description: Question identifiers involved in this investigation

related_challenges.description: Challenge IDs (CH-XXXXXXXX) that triggered or relate to this investigation

related_defects.description: Defect codes (DL-XXX) implicated in this investigation

related_recommendations.description: Recommendation IDs (REC-XXXXXXXX) associated with this investigation

related_sessions.description: Session IDs that created, updated, or resolved this investigation

related_governance_events.description: Governance event IDs (GE-NNNN) associated with this investigation

resolution.description: Resolution summary — required when transitioning to RESOLVED or CLOSED

source.description: How investigation was created: manual, auto-create, from-challenge, from-defect

blocking.description: If true, this investigation blocks further certification of affected QIDs

lifecycleStateMachine.description: Deterministic state transitions for investigation lifecycle management

OPEN.description: Investigation has been created but not yet assigned or active. Awaiting triage.

INVESTIGATING.description: Investigation is assigned and actively in progress. Evidence gathering underway.

ACTION_REQUIRED.description: Findings are complete and require a remediation action before resolution.
ACTION_REQUIRED.note: ACTION_REQUIRED is a mandatory intermediate state when findings identify defects or issues requiring fix/rewrite/archive. Cannot go back to INVESTIGATING — must resolve or close.

RESOLVED.description: Remediation action completed or no action needed. Awaiting independent verification.
RESOLVED.note: RESOLVED requires resolution text, resolution_type, and resolution_author.

CLOSED.description: Resolution verified by independent review, or investigation determined invalid/duplicate. Terminal state.
CLOSED.note: CLOSED is a terminal state. No further transitions permitted.

conditions: At least one finding must be recorded OR the assignment itself acts as the trigger
At least one finding with severity >= MEDIUM
transitionRules.effect: Sets updated_date. Flags as blocking if severity includes CRITICAL.

conditions: Verification documented in findings or resolution
transitionRules.effect: Sets resolution_date to close date. Timeline entry recorded.

conditions: Investigation determined to be invalid or duplicate
resolution_type = DUPLICATE or INVALID or DISMISSED

invalidTransitions.description: The following transitions are rejected with an error
examples: OPEN → RESOLVED (must go through INVESTIGATING first)
RESOLVED → INVESTIGATING (must close or re-open a new investigation)
Any → OPEN when not currently OPEN (cannot re-open)

--create.output: JSON of created investigation to stdout

--auto-create.description: Scan all OPEN challenges and create investigations for those meeting auto-creation criteria
criteria: Challenge status is OPEN or INVESTIGATING
Challenge has linkedDefects that include critical/high defects (DL-008, DL-026, DL-030)
Challenge priority is HIGH or priority score >= min-priority threshold
No existing OPEN/INVESTIGATING investigation with the same QID and defect pairing
--auto-create.output: JSON array of created investigations to stdout

--from-challenge.description: Create an investigation from a specific challenge
--from-challenge.behavior: Reads challenge_registry.json, extracts challenge data, creates linked investigation
--from-challenge.output: JSON of created investigation to stdout

--from-defect.description: Create an investigation from a known defect code
--from-defect.behavior: Creates a DEFECT-type investigation. Derives priority from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md severity.
--from-defect.output: JSON of created investigation to stdout

--list.output: JSON object with summary counts and filtered investigation array

--get.description: Retrieve a full investigation record by ID
--get.output: JSON of full investigation record with timeline and findings

--update.description: Update an investigation's metadata, status, findings, or assignment

--close.description: Close an investigation with required resolution text

--summary.description: Generate a summary dashboard of all investigations
--summary.output: JSON object with counts by status, type, priority band, and recent activity

--stats.description: Generate detailed statistics with QID impact analysis
--stats.output: JSON object with per-defect investigation counts, blocking investigation count, average time-to-resolution

challengeCriteria.deduplication: If an OPEN or INVESTIGATING investigation already exists for all QIDs in the challenge AND all linked defect codes, skip creation.

seedData.description: Initial investigations created from OPEN challenges in the challenge registry

governanceAlignment.agreementWith_CONSTITUTION: Fully compatible. Read-only access to pack files. Writes limited to investigation_registry.json.
governanceAlignment.agreementWith_AGENTS_md: Compliant with §2 (read-only default), §4 (REVISION_HISTORY entries when content changes are triggered), §12 (investigation findings logged before session close).
governanceAlignment.agreementWith_CAQS: Supports §1.6 build-time verification by tracking review dimensions. Supports §9 audit workflow by providing formal investigation lifecycle.
governanceAlignment.agreementWith_DEFECT_LIBRARY: Uses DL-XXX codes as first-class references. Investigations can be spawned from defect library entries.
governanceAlignment.backupProtocol: Investigation registry JSON is a new output artifact (not a pack file). Standard write-then-verify applies.
governanceAlignment.governanceGuardRules: No conflict. Investigation management does not modify pack files. Rule 2 (DL-008) unaffected.
